create_DatatroveFileDataset: create a DatatroveFileDataset from a single .ds file with a given sequence length and token size
create_DatatroveFolderDataset: create a DatatroveFolderDataset from a folder of .ds files with optional shuffling and recursive search
read_DatatroveFileDataset_item: read a sample from a DatatroveFileDataset by index, returning input_ids and optionally positions
read_DatatroveFolderDataset_item: read a sample from a DatatroveFolderDataset by global index across multiple .ds files
get_DatatroveFileDataset_len: get the total number of full sequences in a DatatroveFileDataset based on file size and sequence length
